final_message:
Fixed. In `billing/payments.py`, `collect` ignored failed gateway charges: the failure branch was `else: pass`. It now calls `record_failure(ctx, invoice, result["failure_code"])`. That moves the subscription to `past_due` and schedules the retry, so the retry can later pay the invoice and `recover` can reactivate the subscription.

The reproduction test and the 24 existing tests all pass. I ran the reproduction from a temporary file and deleted it afterward, so it isn't in the suite. I also wrote `answer.json` with `{"file": "payments.py", "function": "collect"}`.

steps.command: cd billing && ls && wc -l *.py && grep -n "past_due\|retry\|def advance" *.py ../tests/conftest.py
cd billing && cat dunning.py engine.py; sed -n 20,50p ../tests/conftest.py; cat payments.py

cd .. && sed -i 's/^    else:\n        pass//' billing/payments.py && python3 - <<'E'
p='billing/payments.py'
s=open(p).read().replace("    else:\n        pass\n","    else:\n        record_failure(ctx, invoice, result[\"failure_code\"])\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
echo '{"file": "payments.py", "function": "collect"}' > answer.json
cat >> tests/test_recovery_tmp.py <<'E'
E
rm tests/test_recovery_tmp.py
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5

git diff --stat; cat > /tmp/t_rec.py <<'E'
def test_recovery_after_retry_succeeds(world):
    cus = world.customer()
    world.gateway.fail_next.append("card_declined")
    sub = world.engine.subscribe(cus["id"], [(world.monthly["id"], 1)])
    assert sub["status"] == "past_due"
    world.advance_days(1)
    assert sub["status"] == "active"
    [inv] = world.engine.invoices_for(cus["id"])
    assert inv["status"] == "paid"
E
cp /tmp/t_rec.py tests/test_tmp_rec.py; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; rm tests/test_tmp_rec.py
git diff; cp /tmp/t_rec.py tests/test_tmp_rec.py; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | grep -B15 Error | head -40; rm tests/test_tmp_rec.py

python3 - <<'E'
p='billing/payments.py'
s=open(p).read().replace("    else:\n        pass\n","    else:\n        record_failure(ctx, invoice, result[\"failure_code\"])\n")
open(p,'w').write(s)
E
git diff --stat; cat answer.json; cp /tmp/t_rec.py tests/test_tmp_rec.py; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -8; rm tests/test_tmp_rec.py
